schematic_container_helper.config.commen: Enable or disable the core features of Container Helper.
If enabled, the mod will continuously find incomplete containers in the background and dispatch the bot to fill them.

OFF: Only fill the container you are currently looking at.
ON: Automatically scan and fill all containers within the specified radius.
The radius for auto-scanning and filling containers in Area Mode (1 - 32 blocks).
The radius for rendering highlight outlines for incomplete containers (1 - 64 blocks).
If enabled, highlights and fill actions only affect containers within current Litematica render layers.
If enabled, the highlight outline will disappear automatically once the container contents match the schematic requirements.
Use data synced by Servux or similar mods to verify inventory states in real-time without opening containers.
Highlight containers in the world that are missing items according to the schematic.
If enabled, highlight outlines will be visible through blocks and terrain (X-Ray).
The color of the highlight outline. Use ARGB hex format (e.g., 0x808B4513).
Interval in ticks between auto-fill actions. Higher values will slow down the filling process.
Allow the mod to automatically open shulker boxes in your inventory to extract required materials.
schematic_container_helper.hotkey.commen: Press this key to execute a fill action immediately.
Hotkey to quickly enable or disable background continuous auto-filling.
Switch between 'Crosshair Target Mode' and 'Area Scan Mode'.
Hotkey to open this configuration menu (Default: L + C).
